mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_leave_req (user_id, leave_type_cd, start_dt, end_dt, start_at, end_at, days, reason, half_type_cd, status_cd, approval_doc_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{leaveTypeCd}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{days}, #{reason}, #{halfTypeCd}, COALESCE(#{statusCd}, 'IN_PROGRESS'), #{approvalDocId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gw_leave_req WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status_cd IN ('IN_PROGRESS','APPROVED') AND deleted_at IS NULL AND ( (leave_type_cd = 'HOURLY' AND start_at < #{endAt} AND end_at > #{startAt}) OR (leave_type_cd != 'HOURLY' AND start_dt <= CAST(#{startAt} AS DATE) AND end_dt >= CAST(#{startAt} AS DATE)) )

SELECT leave_type_cd FROM gw_leave_req WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status_cd IN ('IN_PROGRESS','APPROVED') AND deleted_at IS NULL AND leave_type_cd NOT IN ('HALF','HOURLY') AND start_dt <= #{date} AND end_dt >= #{date} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_leave_req SET status_cd = #{statusCd}, approval_doc_id = COALESCE(#{approvalDocId}, approval_doc_id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE leave_id = #{leaveId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.name AS user_name FROM gw_leave_req r JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.leave_id = #{leaveId}
SELECT r.*, u.name AS user_name FROM gw_leave_req r JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.approval_doc_id = #{docId}
SELECT r.*, u.name AS user_name FROM gw_leave_req r JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT user_id, bal_year, annual_given, annual_used FROM gw_leave_balance WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND bal_year = #{year}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO gw_leave_balance t USING (VALUES (#{userId}, #{year}, #{given})) AS v(user_id, bal_year, annual_given) ON t.user_id = v.user_id AND t.bal_year = v.bal_year WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET annual_given = v.annual_given WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (user_id, bal_year, annual_given, annual_used) VALUES (v.user_id, v.bal_year, v.annual_given, 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT u.user_id, u.name, u.email, u.hire_date, d.dept_nm AS dept_name, #{year} AS bal_year, COALESCE(b.annual_given, 0) AS annual_given, COALESCE(b.annual_used, 0) AS annual_used FROM gw_user u LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN gw_leave_balance b ON b.user_id = u.user_id AND b.bal_year = #{year} WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.use_yn = 'Y'
AND (u.name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.email ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR d.dept_nm ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY d.dept_nm NULLS LAST, u.name
